Name: GRASS_LOD_RANGE_PARAM_ST
Description: Distances of the three grass LOD levels, picked by GrassTypeParam's LOD Range ID. Each level runs out to its Distance, then fades over its Play distance, so it ends at Distance + Play. Distances are in metres. A missing row gives zero distances.

Fields.Name: LOD 0 Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the closest grass LOD ends; it then fades over LOD 0 Play. Retail 3–100 m.

Fields.Name: LOD 0 Play
Fields.Description: Fade length (m) after LOD 0 Distance: LOD 0 ends at Distance + Play. Retail 0–5 m.

Fields.Name: LOD 1 Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the middle grass LOD ends; it then fades over LOD 1 Play. Retail 12–180 m; 0 in row 3, which only sets LOD 0.

Fields.Name: LOD 1 Play
Fields.Description: Fade length (m) after LOD 1 Distance: LOD 1 ends at Distance + Play. Retail mostly 6 m.

Fields.Name: LOD 2 Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the farthest grass LOD ends; it then fades over LOD 2 Play. The largest LOD 2 Distance + Play among the grass types of a grass area also sets how far around the camera that area's grass is gathered (times the area's scale and the load balancer's grass scale). Retail 50–999 m.

Fields.Name: LOD 2 Play
Fields.Description: Fade length (m) after LOD 2 Distance: grass ends at Distance + Play. Retail mostly 12 m.
